purpose: DLL entry point and Notepad++ plugin ABI exports: DllMain, isUnicode, setInfo, getName, getFuncsArray, beNotified, messageProc.
calls_out_to: PluginController::Instance() — all exports delegate to the singleton
invariants: DllMain calls DisableThreadLibraryCalls to avoid DLL_THREAD_ATTACH/DETACH overhead
All exports are declared extern "C" __declspec(dllexport) to match the Notepad++ plugin ABI
gotchas: g_module is stored in DllMain and re-passed to Initialize via setInfo because DllMain's HMODULE and setInfo may be called on different threads in some Npp versions
